newsitem.title: BELGIUM: French children's choir stays clear of Belgium.
newsitem.headline: French children's choir stays clear of Belgium.

text.p: A French children's choir has turned down an invitation to sing in Belgium because of a paedophile kidnap, sex and murder scandal, a Belgian choir leader said on Wednesday.

"The French parents wondered whether it was a good idea to send their children to Belgium, after the paedophile scandal here," Ivo Hendrickx, manager for the Cantabile children's choir in Merksplas, northern Belgium, told Reuters.
The children -- from a choir in Meursault, close to the eastern French town of Dijon -- were to have stayed with parents of Belgian choir members and take part in a concert in May.
A Dutch choir will visit Belkgium for the concert as planned, but children and choir leaders will stay in a separate holiday home, and not with Belgian parents.
Since mid-August, Belgium has been shaken by the discovery of a paedophile ring which has claimed the lives of at least four girls.
